PHILIP MORRIS USA RECORDS MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

PM
PHILIP MORRIS

Date: September 9, 1994

To: Myra Garris

From: Lewis Cummings

Subject: Records Management Commendation

I would like to thank you for the work you have put forth this year on the Philip Morris USA Records Management Program. As you know, much of our emphasis this year has been in the legal environment where we have identified and suspended the appropriate records needed for an unprecedented amount of litigation. As a departmental records coordinator, your efforts in this regard provided an invaluable service to the company.

By coordinating Records Management activities for the Cabarrus Employment, Compensation and Affirmative Action Departments this year, you also played a vital roll in helping Philip Morris fulfill its legal, regulatory and business retention requirements while reducing its overall records maintenance costs. In the cost savings arena this year, I estimate we will reduce our burden of maintaining unnecessary active records at Philip Morris by 30 to 35 million documents and files. This translates into a net saving of nearly 2 million dollars in equipment and materials alone. Other benefits such as a reduction in legal expenses, improved access and retrieval of information, and reduced space requirements will even more dramatically increase these projected savings. Your leadership roll and the support and diligence you put forth this year were imperative to Philip Morris achieving this magnitude of success.

■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ■

As always, I will look forward to continuing to work with you in our future efforts to help Philip Morris manage its records and information resources in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible. If you should have future suggestions about how we can make the program better, please let me know. Thanks again for your contributions and outstanding support.

2051065355
